title: US Trade Deficit Hits 17-Month High of $105.6 Billion
detail: The US trade deficit surged to a 17-month high of $105.6 billion in the latest report, driven by a sharp increase in imports of oil and other goods. The figure underscores ongoing pressures on the US current account balance amid continued global supply chain shifts and energy market dynamics.

media.caption: US trade deficit reaches $105.6 billion, a 17-month high
